# BATD Academy

> > Professional training and development institute offering multilingual courses in management, HR, and specialized fields across global locations.

BATD Academy (British Academy for Training and Development) is an international training organization delivering professional development programs in English and Arabic across major cities including London, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, New York, Manchester, Geneva, Zurich, Singapore, Tokyo, Washington, Toronto, and Riyadh. The academy specializes in management training, HR development, project management, and corporate consulting services.

## Specialized Courses

- [دورة تدريبية في إدارة الإنشاءات ومشاريع الهندسة المعمارية](https://batdacademy.com/ar/course_details/1330/دورة-تدريبية-في-إدارة-الإنشاءات-ومشاريع-الهندسة-المعمارية-وفق-المعايير-التكنولوجية-الحديثة): Construction management and architecture projects training course with modern standards.
- [دورة التحضير لاختبار DMBoK وشهادة CDMP: أساسيات إدارة البيانات](https://batdacademy.com/ar/course_details/3104/دورة-التحضير-لاختبار-DMBoK-وشهادة-CDMP:-أساسيات-إدارة-البيانات): Data management certification prep course for DMBoK and CDMP professional credentials.
- [الهدف من الرقابة على المعلومات والتقنيات ذات الصلة COBIT](https://batdacademy.com/ar/course_details/3147/الهدف-من-الرقابة-على-المعلومات-والتقنيات-ذات-الصلة-COBIT): COBIT framework training covering IT governance, risk management, and compliance.
- [التصوير الفوتوغرافي](https://batdacademy.com/ar/course_details/2789/التصوير-الفوتوغرافي): Photography training course developing professional technical and commercial skills.

## Services & Consulting

- [خدمات الاستشارات والإدارة](https://batdacademy.com/ar/page/استشارات-وحلول-إدارية): Management consulting and strategic planning services for European government sectors.
- [مجلس المستشارين](https://batdacademy.com/ar/page/مجلس_المستشارين): Advisory board and professional development courses across international locations.
